description: Discover My Skydome, a unique 200m² architect-designed loft filled with natural light thanks to a stunning central skylight. Located in the heart of the Haut Marais, this stylish space features 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, full A/C, a modern kitchen, high-speed Wi-Fi, and a spacious living area. Perfect for families, groups, or business travelers, all within walking distance to galleries, restaurants, boutiques, and iconic Paris landmarks.The space> The Space – My SkydomeWelcome to My Skydome, a rare architectural gem in the heart of the Haut Marais, just steps from Place de la République. This exceptional 200m² designer loft is the result of a bold renovation by an Italian architect and a Parisian interior designer. Framed by the original 1896 stone-and-glass courtyard, this space combines natural materials and cutting-edge comfort in an atmosphere of light and volume.Ideal for families, groups, or business travelers, this home is more than just a place to stay — it's a destination in itself.After a day exploring Paris’s museums and iconic neighborhoods, come home to your private jacuzzi, sauna, fitness room, or relax over a game of billiards under the skylight.> Living Areas & KitchenLarge central living room with 2 sofas, 2 chairs, 2 velvet benches, billiards table, and a bar area (fridge, sink, Nespresso machine)Fully equipped open kitchen: refrigerator, freezer, oven, microwave, stovetop, dishwasher, coffee machine, kettle, toaster, blender, and full cookwareDining room with a stone table for 10 guests and USB ports connected to a ceiling projector> Bedrooms & Sleeping ArrangementsBedroom 1: king-size bed (180x200), TV, wardrobe, desk, ensuite bathroom with shower, double sink, hairdryer, WCBedroom 2: king-size bed, TV, wardrobe, desk, ensuite bathroom with shower, dou
